Definition: Teman, the name of two Edomites, and of the region and descendant of one of them
BiblicalUsage: Teman = "south"; n pr m; 1) son of Eliphaz, grandson of Esau, and one of the dukes of Edom; 2) the tribe descended from 1 noted for the wisdom of its people; n pr loc; 3) the region occupied by the descendants of 1, located east of Idumea
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
